seo_title: Logo Design Course | Illustrator, 5 Weeks, ₹5,900 | Nova Skills
seo_description: Learn original logo concepts, vector precision, typography and testing in Illustrator. Build 3 concepts and 2 refined logos in 5 weeks, 40 hours, for ₹5,900.
overview: Logo Design & Vector Identity Marks is an intensive 5-week, 40-hour applied design specialization focused exclusively on the art and science of logo creation. Moving systematically through the professional design arc—Research, Ideation, Sketching, Vector Craftsmanship, Optical Refinement, Multi-Size Testing, and Client Delivery—students learn how to engineer original, meaningful, and technically flawless marks that command client confidence and endure across diverse media.
why_now: Every business requires a distinctive logo, yet the digital market is overwhelmed by generic stock templates and AI-generated clipart. Brands demand designers who possess genuine conceptual problem-solving skills, optical refinement capabilities, and the technical discipline to build pristine, scalable vector artwork that functions seamlessly from 16px favicons to building signage.
prerequisites: Basic computer literacy (file navigation, downloading, saving)
Willingness to sketch, experiment, and iterate visual ideas on paper
Recommended: Basic typography awareness, general design principles, or introductory vector familiarity
No advanced design degree required; foundational Illustrator concepts are taught systematically
target_audience: Beginner graphic designers seeking focused mastery in logo conceptualization and vector execution
Aspiring logo designers wanting to build an agency-ready portfolio of original marks
Adobe Illustrator learners looking to advance beyond software tutorials into commercial design craftsmanship
Freelance designers aiming to command higher project fees by delivering professional multi-format logo packages
Marketing creatives and brand assistants needing to evaluate, refine, and adapt corporate logos
Visual communication students desiring practical training in typography, kerning, and optical balance
learning_outcomes: Translate client discovery briefs into defined brand attributes and actionable visual design objectives.
Perform competitor logo audits to identify category visual conventions and discover differentiation opportunities.
Generate diverse visual ideas using mind mapping, word association, thumbnail sketching, and negative space techniques.
Construct precise, scalable vector shapes in Adobe Illustrator using the Pen Tool, Bézier curves, and Shape Builder.
Design custom wordmarks and lettermarks with optical kerning, custom ligature adjustments, and preserved editable masters.
Apply optical corrections and visual overshoot to geometric marks, balancing perceptual weight over mathematical rigidity.
Build responsive logo variations including primary marks, secondary horizontal lockups, compact symbols, and monochrome versions.
Execute rigorous multi-context stress tests from 16px favicons to print applications, ensuring legibility and contrast.
Conduct preliminary trademark similarity screening on public databases while understanding legal clearance boundaries.
Package standardized 9-folder client handover archives featuring native .ai source files, scalable SVGs, vector PDFs, and transparent PNGs.

faq.question: What is Logo Design & Vector Identity Marks?
faq.answer: Logo Design & Vector Identity Marks is an intensive 5-week, 40-hour applied specialization focused on original concept development, sketch-to-vector workflows, precision Adobe Illustrator construction, custom wordmark typography, optical refinement, responsive size testing, and client-ready logo delivery.

faq.question: Is this course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The course is structured from Beginner to Applied level. While familiarity with design principles or vector tools is helpful, foundational Illustrator mechanics (Pen Tool, Bézier curves, layers, shapes) are taught from the ground up before advancing to complex geometry and optical corrections.

faq.question: What is the duration and fee?
faq.answer: The course spans 5 Weeks (40 guided training hours). The approved regular tuition fee for Logo Design & Vector Identity Marks is ₹5,900. Under our current introductory launch offer, an approved launch fee of ₹5,900 is available. The final payable amount, including any applicable taxes, will be clearly displayed before payment. All live instructional sessions, portfolio reviews, and certification are included.

faq.question: Which software will I learn?
faq.answer: You will master Adobe Illustrator as your primary vector design engine for all sketches, paths, curves, geometry, wordmarks, and exports. Adobe Photoshop is used as a supporting tool for photorealistic presentation mockups and contextual previews.

faq.question: Do I need prior Illustrator experience?
faq.answer: Prior experience is helpful but not strictly required. The curriculum introduces vector paths, anchor point editing, and the Pen Tool systematically in Module 3. What is essential is basic computer literacy and a willingness to sketch and iterate ideas on paper.

faq.question: Will I learn logo research?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 1 is dedicated to research and discovery: unpacking client briefs, identifying brand personality attributes, analyzing competitor visual clichés, exploring visual metaphors, and establishing criteria for distinctiveness.

faq.question: Does the course teach professional sketching?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 2 emphasizes thumbnail sketching and rapid ideation. You will learn how to visually brainstorm with mind maps, explore negative space, experiment with letterforms, and evaluate concept silhouettes before opening Adobe Illustrator.

faq.question: Will I learn negative-space logo design?
faq.answer: Yes. You will study figure-ground relationships and negative-space construction techniques using Illustrator's Shape Builder and Pathfinder tools, learning to craft purposeful visual double-meanings without forcing artificial visual tricks.

faq.question: Will I learn Pen Tool and Bézier curves?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 3 provides deep technical instruction on Bézier handles, direction lines, anchor point reduction, corner vs. smooth points, path simplification, and creating pristine, mathematically clean vector paths.

faq.question: Does the course cover custom wordmarks?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn wordmark craftsmanship, including font pairing, letterform modification, tracking, custom kerning, ligature concepts, baseline alignment, and preserving live editable text masters alongside outlined release copies.

faq.question: Will I learn geometric logo construction?
faq.answer: Yes. You will explore geometric grids, circle construction, proportional ratios, and symmetry. However, the course teaches that geometric grids are construction aids, not rigid formulas—optical balance always takes precedence over mathematical alignment.

faq.question: What is optical refinement?
faq.answer: Optical refinement is adjusting vector shapes to compensate for human visual perception. It includes applying overshoot to circular forms so they appear equal in height to flat letters, adjusting letter spacing optically, and centering irregular symbols visually rather than mathematically.

faq.question: How many logo concepts will I create?
faq.answer: Every student creates three distinct original concept directions supported by research, mind maps, and sketches during Module 2, exploring varied symbolic and typographic approaches.

faq.question: How many logos will I fully refine?
faq.answer: From the three initial concepts, you will select and fully develop two complete vector logo solutions in Module 3, taking both through precision vector construction, typography, optical tuning, and contextual testing.

faq.question: Will I learn monochrome logo variations?
faq.answer: Yes. You will test and build 100% black (monochrome) and white reversed-out versions for both refined solutions, ensuring the mark's silhouette remains powerful and legible without relying on color or gradients.

faq.question: Will I learn favicon and small-size testing?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 4 includes stress testing at microscopic scales (16×16px favicon, 32×32px app icon, 64×64px avatar, mobile headers), teaching you how to create simplified compact variants when detailed marks degrade at small sizes.

faq.question: Will I receive editable Illustrator source files?
faq.answer: Yes. You work with native, layered Adobe Illustrator (.ai) files and learn industry standards for organizing artwork layers, naming conventions, eliminating stray points, and packaging editable source files for clients.

faq.question: Does the course include SVG/PDF/PNG exports?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 5 covers multi-format export standards: clean scalable vector graphics (SVG) for web, vector PDFs for print, and transparent PNGs at multiple resolutions for digital applications.

faq.question: Will I learn professional logo presentation?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn to build an executive presentation deck that walks clients through the strategic research arc, sketches, concept rationale, optical adjustments, and real-world mockups, facilitating objective feedback.

faq.question: Will I learn trademark similarity checking?
faq.answer: Yes. The curriculum introduces preliminary originality screening using public databases (IP India Trademark Public Search, WIPO Global Brand Database) to check identical names, phonetic similarities, and visual category conventions.

faq.question: Does this course guarantee trademark registration?
faq.answer: No. Preliminary designer screening is an educational exercise in risk awareness. A designer cannot guarantee trademark availability, legal registrability, or global exclusivity. Formal trademark clearance must always be conducted by a qualified trademark attorney.

faq.question: Is the course different from Brand Identity Design?
faq.answer: Yes. Course 54 specializes in the craftsmanship, geometry, typography, and delivery of original logo marks. Course 52 (Brand Identity Design & Visual Systems) covers broad brand strategy, complete visual identity systems, multi-touchpoint stationery, packaging, and 12–20 page brand guidelines.

faq.question: Does the course include full brand guidelines?
faq.answer: No. Course 54 teaches a concise, practical 1-page logo usage and clear-space specification sheet. Extensive brand identity guidelines belong to Course 52.

faq.question: Is this an official Adobe certification?
faq.answer: No. This is an institutional certificate of completion issued by Nova Skills Education Institute upon passing the assessment rubric and portfolio review. It is not an Adobe-sponsored credential.

faq.question: Are Adobe subscriptions included?
faq.answer: No. Students must have an active Adobe Creative Cloud subscription covering Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop on their own computer.

faq.question: What beginner freelance services could I offer?
faq.answer: Graduates are equipped to offer logo design, custom wordmark creation, vector mark refinement, sketch vectorization, logo modernization, responsive logo adaptations, and client-ready vector logo delivery packages.
